name: herdr
description: Run a herdr multi-agent worker fleet. herdr-orchestrator decomposes the work, spawns and assigns workers by tier, answers blocked workers and integrates results through the horch CLI. herdr-worker is the other side of that protocol. herdr-atomic wraps the herdr terminal workspace manager in deterministic scripts. herdr-setup checks the machine (herdr CLI, horch on PATH, agent integrations) and fills only the gaps. Requires the herdr CLI (herdr.dev), which is not bundled.
